units.title: SG-2 Typed asset manifest and validated content schemas
Act: Add zod and manifest/object schemas
Act: Author the-boys-room manifest, scene and asset folders
Verify: Manifest and object schema unit tests

tests.name: accepts a spritesheet entry with frames, animations, origin and interactionBounds
tests.title: assetManifestSchema accepts a valid spritesheet entry with frames, animations, origin and interactionBounds
tests.scenario: Given a spritesheet entry with frames, animations, origin and interactionBounds, When the manifest is parsed, Then it succeeds and keeps those fields
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t assetManifestSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects an entry missing id, reporting the issue at assets[0].id
tests.title: assetManifestSchema rejects an entry missing id with issue path ['assets', 0, 'id']
tests.scenario: Given a manifest whose first asset has no id, When parsed, Then it fails with an issue at path assets.0.id
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t assetManifestSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects an entry with a negative width
tests.title: assetManifestSchema rejects a negative width
tests.scenario: Given a spritesheet entry with width -1, When parsed, Then it fails with an issue at path assets.0.width
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t assetManifestSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects an entry whose type is not a known asset type
tests.title: assetManifestSchema rejects an unknown asset type 'bogus'
tests.scenario: Given a spritesheet entry with type 'bogus', When parsed, Then it fails with an issue at path assets.0.type
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t assetManifestSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: parses an object with position, layer, bounds, actions, visibleWhen and persistentState
tests.title: worldObjectSchema parses a fully specified object with position, layer furniture, bounds, actions, visibleWhen and persistentState
tests.scenario: Given an object with position, layer 'furniture', bounds, actions ['inspect','push'], visibleWhen [{flag:'x',equals:true}] and persistentState {flag:'secret_open'}, When parsed, Then it succeeds and keeps those fields
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t worldObjectSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: defaults scale to 1 when it is omitted
tests.title: worldObjectSchema defaults scale to 1 when omitted
tests.scenario: Given a valid object without scale, When parsed, Then result scale is 1
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t worldObjectSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects a layer that is not defined
tests.title: worldObjectSchema rejects layer 'sky'
tests.scenario: Given an object with layer 'sky', When parsed, Then it fails with an issue at path layer
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t worldObjectSchema --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects an action that is not defined
tests.title: worldObjectSchema rejects action 'fly'
tests.scenario: Given an object with actions ['fly'], When parsed, Then it fails with an issue at path actions.0
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts -t worldObjectSchema --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: the-boys-room content and folder unit tests

tests.name: manifest.json parses against assetManifestSchema
tests.title: the-boys-room content: manifest.json parses against assetManifestSchema
tests.scenario: Given the shipped the-boys-room manifest.json, When validated against assetManifestSchema, Then it parses without issues
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: scene.json parses against sceneSchema
tests.title: the-boys-room content: scene.json parses against sceneSchema
tests.scenario: Given the shipped the-boys-room scene.json, When validated against sceneSchema, Then it parses without issues
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: boysRoomContent.test.ts::every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids
tests.name: every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids
tests.title: the-boys-room content: every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids
tests.scenario: Given the parsed manifest and scene, When each scene object's asset is checked, Then no scene object references an undeclared asset
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: boysRoomContent.test.ts::all 9 required asset directories exist under public/assets
tests.name: all 9 required asset directories exist under public/assets
tests.title: the-boys-room content: all 9 required asset directories exist under public/assets
tests.scenario: Given the required asset directories for the-boys-room and shared UI, When each directory is checked on disk, Then none of the required directories is missing
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

attempts.failure: Verify tests failed (3): manifest.json parses against assetManifestSchema, scene.json parses against sceneSchema, every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids

tests.name: manifest.json parses against assetManifestSchema
tests.title: manifest.json parses against assetManifestSchema
tests.scenario: Given the shipped the-boys-room manifest.json, When it is validated against assetManifestSchema, Then it parses without issues
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: assets: Expected array, received object. The shipped manifest uses a keyed object ("backgrounds/bedroom": {...}) with type "image" and a "dimensions" field, neither of which the schema accepts.

tests.name: scene.json parses against sceneSchema
tests.title: scene.json parses against sceneSchema
tests.scenario: Given the shipped the-boys-room scene.json, When it is validated against sceneSchema, Then it parses without issues
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: objects[*].actions[*]: expected 'inspect'|'push'|'search'|'leave', received object. All 5 scene objects use action objects ({id,label,events}) instead of action id strings, 10 issues in total.

tests.name: every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids
tests.title: every scene object asset is declared in the manifest ids
tests.scenario: Given the parsed manifest and scene, When each object's asset is checked against manifest ids, Then no object references an undeclared asset
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Blocked by the manifest schema failure: assetManifestSchema.parse throws ZodError (assets expected array). The check is not reached, so the asset-id linkage is unverified.

tests.name: all 9 required asset directories exist under public/assets
tests.title: all 9 required asset directories exist under public/assets
tests.scenario: Given the 9 required asset directories for the-boys-room and shared UI, When each is checked on disk, Then none is missing
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/boysRoomContent.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Manifest loader dangling-reference and missing-asset unit tests

tests.id: loadManifest > reports no errors, missing assets or dangling references for valid data when every path exists
tests.name: loadManifest: valid data with exists=()=>true
tests.title: loadManifest reports no errors, missing assets or dangling references for valid data when every path exists
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest and scene and exists always returns true, When loadManifest runs, Then errors, missing and dangling are empty and manifest and scene are non-null
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: loadManifest > lists every asset id as missing without throwing when no path exists
tests.name: loadManifest: exists=()=>false
tests.title: loadManifest lists every asset id as missing without throwing when no path exists
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest and exists always returns false, When loadManifest runs, Then it does not throw and missing contains all asset ids
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: loadManifest > reports a scene object whose asset id is absent from the manifest as dangling
tests.name: loadManifest: scene object with asset 'nope'
tests.title: loadManifest reports a scene object whose asset id is absent from the manifest as dangling
tests.scenario: Given a scene object referencing asset 'nope' not in the manifest, When loadManifest runs, Then dangling contains that object id and asset
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: loadManifest > reports parse errors and a null manifest when manifest data is an empty object
tests.name: loadManifest: manifestData {}
tests.title: loadManifest reports parse errors and a null manifest when manifest data is an empty object
tests.scenario: Given manifest data {}, When loadManifest runs, Then errors is non-empty and manifest is null
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: loadManifest > does not throw when manifest data is undefined
tests.name: loadManifest: manifestData undefined
tests.title: loadManifest does not throw when manifest data is undefined
tests.scenario: Given manifest data undefined, When loadManifest runs, Then it does not throw and reports errors with a null manifest
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: resolveAsset > returns the manifest entry for an asset that is present and not missing
tests.name: resolveAsset: present asset
tests.title: resolveAsset returns the manifest entry for an asset that is present and not missing
tests.scenario: Given a loaded report where desk_asset is present, When resolveAsset is called with desk_asset, Then it returns that manifest entry
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t resolveAsset --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: resolveAsset > returns FALLBACK_ASSET for an id that was reported missing
tests.name: resolveAsset: id in missing
tests.title: resolveAsset returns FALLBACK_ASSET for an id that was reported missing
tests.scenario: Given a report where desk_asset is in missing, When resolveAsset is called with desk_asset, Then it returns FALLBACK_ASSET
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t resolveAsset --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: resolveAsset > returns FALLBACK_ASSET for an id that is not in the manifest
tests.name: resolveAsset: unknown id
tests.title: resolveAsset returns FALLBACK_ASSET for an id that is not in the manifest
tests.scenario: Given a report whose manifest lacks unknown_asset, When resolveAsset is called with unknown_asset, Then it returns FALLBACK_ASSET
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t resolveAsset --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/manifestLoader.test.ts > loadManifest > reports no errors, missing assets or dangling references for valid data when every path exists
tests.title: reports no errors, missing assets or dangling references for valid data when every path exists
tests.scenario: Given valid manifest and scene data and exists returns true, When loadManifest runs, Then errors, missing and dangling are empty and manifest and scene are set
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.title: lists every asset id as missing without throwing when no path exists
tests.scenario: Given exists returns false for every path, When loadManifest runs, Then it does not throw and missing lists all asset ids
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.title: reports a scene object whose asset id is absent from the manifest as dangling
tests.scenario: Given a scene object referencing asset 'nope' absent from the manifest, When loadManifest runs, Then dangling contains that object id and asset

tests.name: tests/manifestLoader.test.ts > loadManifest > reports parse errors and a null manifest when manifest data is an empty object
tests.title: reports parse errors and a null manifest when manifest data is an empty object
tests.scenario: Given manifestData is {}, When loadManifest runs, Then errors is non-empty and manifest is null
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts -t loadManifest --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/manifestLoader.test.ts > loadManifest > does not throw when manifest data is undefined
tests.title: does not throw when manifest data is undefined
tests.scenario: Given manifestData is undefined, When loadManifest runs, Then it does not throw and reports errors with a null manifest

tests.name: tests/manifestLoader.test.ts > resolveAsset > returns the manifest entry for an asset that is present and not missing
tests.title: returns the manifest entry for an asset that is present and not missing
tests.scenario: Given a loaded report where desk_asset exists, When resolveAsset is called with desk_asset, Then the manifest entry is returned
